rules.description: Trusted user requests may use read-only tools.
rules.rationale: The authenticated user's own question may drive retrieval and summarization.

rules.description: Confidential query results reach Slack only with human approval.
rules.rationale: Internal numbers leaving the company boundary needs a sign-off.

rules.description: Deny untrusted or conditional input to sensitive tools.
rules.rationale: Web text or query output must not be able to drive further database access.

rules.description: Deny untrusted input to external actions.
rules.rationale: A poisoned web page must never cause outbound messages.
